title: Multi page site structure
when: The request needs several pages (home, about, services, contact) that share a header, nav and footer.
prompt:
Goal: Several static pages that feel like one site: same header, nav, footer and styles, with correct links.
Steps:
1. Write the page list and file names first: index.html, about.html, services.html, contact.html.
2. Build one page fully, then copy its header, nav and footer exactly into the others.
3. Mark the current page link with aria-current="page" in each file.
4. One shared style.css and, if needed, one shared main.js; no per page duplicates.
5. Use relative links that exist; each page has its own title and meta description.
Quality bar:
- Nav order and labels are identical on every page.
- Each page has a unique, descriptive title.
- No broken local links.
Pitfalls:
- Pages drifting apart in markup.
- Linking to pages that were not written.
- Same title on every page.
Verify:
- [ ] Every local link resolves.
- [ ] aria-current on the active link.
- [ ] One h1 per page.
- [ ] Shared CSS linked everywhere.
Output: One HTML file per page, style.css, optional main.js.

examples.input: site com home, sobre, serviços e contato
examples.output: 4 HTML files sharing header and footer, aria-current per page, one style.css
